comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The upcoming new battle-ship Adventure Galley, based on William Kidd's sailing ship. Looks like the ivyro already update it with the skill list, level requirements and stats, but what should be mentioned here is the ship is buildable in London and Boston, with Large 2-decked hull.

Comes in Order of the Prince Chapter 3 Honor in 23th January 2019.

(And no, it isn't a rowing ship despite the name)
